results: High-frequency native feed changes do not repeatedly redraw the countdown
Non-responsive content-script notifications cannot block break start/end or leave the worker queue stuck
Search content is visible before slow IPC resolves, including result grids that reuse the home-feed id
Hidden or empty native login placeholders do not trigger a full-page search veil
Closing a login overlay releases the search veil even when the site retains the hidden dialog DOM
SPA navigation back to a home route immediately restores the recommendation guard
A stalled settings read has a deadline and cannot keep an entry page white or disable its search form
Restoring a cached document clears stale ending flags and prevents a permanent blank page or delayed unwanted redirect
Back navigation leaves the entry form usable for another search
A one-time rule-restore failure is retryable and does not poison every subsequent break request
Delayed initial settings snapshots cannot overwrite newer theme, language, or custom-note changes from another tab
scope: Isolated Edge loads a temporary extension copy with a startup API-fault shim; websites mocked; persisted pageshow simulated explicitly.
